company.name: nGrow.ai
company.shortDescription: nGrow.ai is an AI-driven customer engagement platform with no SDK.
company.description:
nGrow is a no SDK solution for push notification marketing.
nGrow is offering no code integration to Google Firebase, Amplitude and other analytical platforms
With nGrow AI tool, customers see up to 30% incremental Revenue growth helping follow iOS15+ and Android push notification policies.
The company was founded by a Marketing Director and a Tech co-founder, with 8+ years of experience in connecting AI and marketing across 40+ apps. 
We launched nGrow in November 2021, and now it delivers 150M notifications daily.
We’re backed by Y Combinator and ex-Dropbox and ex-Google investors.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automates and optimizes customer engagement through AI-powered push notifications, email automation, and lifecycle marketing without requiring SDK integration.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Driven Customer Engagement Platform

productsAndServices.name: Push Notification Automation and Optimization

productsAndServices.description: A tool that segments users using any data from mobile analytics platforms and applies machine learning to predict user behavior and churn for targeted marketing.
productsAndServices.name: Behavioral Segmentation and Predictive Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A feature that delivers contextually relevant messages within mobile apps to guide users, provide personalized recommendations, and gather feedback during app usage.
productsAndServices.name: In-App Messaging

productsAndServices.description: A system that tracks and reports detailed engagement metrics of push notifications and campaigns, including user interactions beyond clicks, to measure true customer engagement.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Analytics and Reporting
